items.coder_A: Experimental intervention is NanoTherm magnetic hyperthermia with implanted iron oxide nanoparticles, registered as a device; if the nanoparticles were treated as a device-activated drug (C12) the trial would have a candidate.
items.reason: The intervention is '[DEVICE] NanoTherm therapy' using 'NanoTherm ASI ... a sterile suspension of iron oxide nanoparticles' heated by the NanoActivator; the antitumour effect is physical heat ('hyperthermia effect'), not a pharmacological action, and the product is described as a 'therapy system'. Devices are excluded intervention types (§1.2); C12 covers drugs with their own antitumour pharmacology activated by a device.

items.coder_A: NanoTherm iron oxide nanoparticle suspension is registered as a device for magnetic hyperthermia; treated as a device, not a pharmacological agent.
